description: Set the meat ahead of the sermon, and Thursday ahead of today.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Sat at the board with the household.
name: Edmund Shakespeare

description: Claimed Thursday for the row, and kept the nail.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Reported that the hand had come away in the porch.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Answered the maltsters with the trades that had burned, and the lofts that had not.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Did the vicar, and kept the chimney for Thursday.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Said his name once, and then asked for the loaf.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Sat at the board after the walk back.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Kept yesterday's count, and Saturday's widow off the table.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Brought the sermon home unimproved, and left the shop unpromised.
name: William Shakespeare
